answer: Proof of useful work provides robust Sybil resistance by anchoring identity to verifiable computation. Agents must solve complex tasks, placing the nadir of efficiency at a clear economic threshold. This mechanism forces attackers to cross a steep ridge of hardware and energy expenditure that cannot be bypassed with velvet promises of status. By requiring non-transferable cryptographic proofs, the network ensures that each identity costs real capital, rendering mass fabrication prohibitively expensive.
